# Read original semver.py
with open('semver.py', 'r') as f:
    original = f.read()

# Build new version incrementally
lines = []

# Header
lines.append('"""')
lines.append('Python helper for Semantic Versioning (http://semver.org/)')
lines.append('"""')
lines.append('')
lines.append('import argparse')  # For CLI (R6)
lines.append('import collections')
lines.append('import re')
lines.append('import sys')  # For CLI (R6)
lines.append('')
lines.append("__version__ = '2.8.1'")
lines.append("__author__ = 'Kostiantyn Rybnikov'")
lines.append("__author_email__ = 'k-bx@k-bx.com'")
lines.append("__maintainer__ = 'Sebastien Celles'")
lines.append('__maintainer_email__ = "s.celles@gmail.com"')
lines.append('')

# _REGEX stays the same
lines.append('_REGEX = re.compile(')
regex_str = r'''        r"""
        ^
        (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        (\-(?P<prerelease>
            (?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)
            (\.(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*
        ))?
        (\+(?P<build>
            [0-9A-Za-z-]+
            (\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*
        ))?
        $
        """'''
lines.append(regex_str + ', re.VERBOSE)')
lines.append('')
lines.append("_LAST_NUMBER = re.compile(r'(?:[^\\d]*(\\d+)[^\\d]*)+')")
lines.append('')

print("Header done. Lines so far:", len(lines))
